home.title: Card Messages & What to Write in a Card | 123Greetings Blog
home.contentText:
The message you write on a card is often the icing on the cake. A beautiful card captures the moment, but the words inside make it truly personal and memorable.

 

At 123Greetings, we’ve carefully crafted messages for every occasion and relationship. We offer cards from birthdays, anniversaries, and holidays to thank-you notes, sympathy messages, friendship wishes, and more. Each message is written by people who specialize in understanding emotions and the many ways we connect with one another.

 
You’ve already chosen the perfect card. Now, if you’re wondering what exactly to say, we’re here to help.
 
Browse through hundreds of greeting messages, wishes, quotes, and card sentiments. You may find the perfect words that express exactly how you feel, discover ideas that inspire your own message, or simply copy and paste a message that speaks to your heart.
 
Whether you’re sending love, gratitude, encouragement, congratulations, or comfort, you’ll find thoughtful words for every occasion and relationship.
 
Because sometimes finding the right words is the hardest part and the most important one. Let us help you say what matters most.
